title: Affogato Ice Cream
description: Classic Italian affogato made healthy — protein vanilla ice cream poured over with espresso. Requires a Ninja Creami.
steps: Combine milk, protein powder and a pinch of salt in a Ninja Creami pint. Shake; freeze 24+ hours.
Process in Ninja Creami on Ice Cream setting; repeat once more.
Brew fresh espresso or strong coffee.
Scoop ice cream into a bowl; pour hot coffee over. Serve immediately.
notes: No Ninja Creami? Buy low-calorie vanilla ice cream like Halo Top instead.
